name: youtube
title: YouTube
description: Search YouTube from the panel, with thumbnails, channels, lengths and views, and trending when nothing is typed. Open a video in the browser, play it in IINA, mpv or VLC, or save it to Watch Later; works with a free API key or an Invidious instance.
author: pal

settings.label: Data API key
settings.description: A Google Cloud API key with YouTube Data API v3 enabled on its project (console.cloud.google.com › APIs & Services › Enable APIs › YouTube Data API v3 › Credentials). Free; the daily quota of 10,000 units is about 100 searches. Wins over the Invidious instance when both are set.

settings.label: Invidious instance
settings.description: Searched without a key through `/api/v1`. Most public instances have turned the API off (only invidious.f5.si answered on 2026-09-17); a self-hosted one is the reliable choice.

settings.label: Player
settings.description: What cmd+Enter plays the video in. Auto takes IINA, then mpv, then VLC, whichever is installed, else the browser. mpv and VLC need yt-dlp for YouTube.

options.title: Auto (IINA, mpv, VLC, else the browser)

settings.label: Region
settings.description: A two-letter country code for the trending list; empty is YouTube's default.

store.tagline: Search YouTube, then open, play or save for later
features: Videos with thumbnail, channel, length, views and age; trending while nothing is typed
`enter` opens in the browser, `cmd+enter` plays in IINA, mpv or VLC, `cmd+c` copies the link
Watch Later (`cmd+s`), its videos found by title at the root
Channels by name, with their latest videos
A free YouTube Data API key, or an Invidious instance without one
`yt: lofi` at the root answers inline

screenshots.caption: A search for lofi: each video with its channel, length, views and age, and the detail pane with the thumbnail
With nothing typed, the videos trending in your region
Open it, play it in your own player, copy the link, keep it for later or go to the channel
Channels by name, each with its avatar and what it is about; Enter lists a channel's latest videos
Watch Later: the videos cmd+S kept, on this Mac and no account needed
Before it is set up: the one setting to fill, a free API key or an Invidious instance

actions.title: Play in player
actions.description: IINA, mpv or VLC per the `player` setting; the browser when none is installed.

actions.title: Latest videos
actions.description: On a channel row: its videos, newest first.

search.title: YouTube
search.description: Type to search videos; nothing typed lists what is trending. `yt:` at the root answers inline.

keys.title: Play in IINA, mpv or VLC

channels.title: YouTube Channels
channels.description: Channels by name; Enter lists the channel's latest videos. Subscriptions need OAuth and are not listed.

later.title: Watch Later
later.description: Videos kept with cmd+s, newest first; the same actions, and cmd+d removes one.
